summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Stadium VIP & Pro Plans pricing feature. All 11 backend tests passed (7 tiers listing with correct prices/features, select endpoint with trial creation, invalid tier 400, status endpoint is_pro/is_vip/tier_key logic). Frontend pricing page renders correctly from Profile -> Go Pro navigation, VIP section with $4.98 price, Fan Favourite badge, First month free tag, 3 perk cards, feature list, Creator tiers (Individual $11.98, Student $9.98, Couple/Duo $14.98, Family $20.98), Band tiers (Adult Band $17.98, Under-18 Band $2.98), and competition reward banner all present. Get Stadium VIP click triggers subscription and shows success toast; button updates to Current Plan.
critical_code_review_comments: Subscription selection does not validate user_id format (empty string would still create a subscription). Low priority since user_id is UUID-generated client-side.
No Stripe or real payment integration yet — tier selection immediately creates 'trial' status as expected per problem statement (acknowledged as mock flow).
SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS is hardcoded in server.py (within 1244-1382). Acceptable for current scope but could be moved to a config/seed collection for maintainability.
test_credentials: None — app is open-access, user_id auto-generated UUID in localStorage
seed_data_creation: Test subscriptions created with TEST_ prefixed user_ids; no cleanup performed (test data isolated by unique UUID user_ids per test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscriptions feature fully working end-to-end. Backend endpoints at /api/subscriptions/tiers, /api/subscriptions/select, /api/subscriptions/{user_id}/status. Frontend PricingPage.js reached via Profile -> go-pro-btn (data-testid). Key testids: pricing-page, vip-section, vip-tier-name, vip-select-btn, tier-card-{key}, tier-select-{key}, creator-tiers-section, band-tiers-section, competition-reward-banner.
